scripts.check-uv: uv --version || (echo 'uv not found. Install with: brew install uv' && exit 1)
scripts.install-deps: npm run check-uv && uv python install 3.11 && uv sync --system-certs
scripts.dev: npm run check-uv && uv run mkdocs serve --livereload
scripts.build: npm run check-uv && uv run mkdocs build
